findings.current: “If monsters like you exist, why can’t there be monsters like them?”
findings.defect: The Skeleton King calls Jin a monstrous human, not a monster. The draft erases the human-versus-monster contrast.
findings.rationale: 괴물 같은 인간 explicitly identifies Jin as human while comparing him to the monsters.
findings.replacement: “If a human as monstrous as you can exist, why can’t monsters like them?”
findings.source: 네놈처럼 괴물 같은 인간도 있는데, 저런 놈들도 있을 수 있잖나.

findings.current:
“Do you have to say something so obnoxious like it’s the most natural thing in the world?”

“Talking about obnoxious? You’ve really become Korean. Weren’t you supposed to be playing a foreigner?”
findings.defect: Rendering 밥맛 없는 as “obnoxious” removes the reference to appetite that Jin immediately picks up for his joke.
findings.rationale: Jin’s response turns on the Skeleton King using 밥맛, literally ‘taste for food’ or appetite.
findings.replacement:
“Do you have to say things that put me off my food like it’s nothing?”

“Food? You’ve really become Korean. Weren’t you supposed to be playing a foreigner?”
findings.source:
“밥맛 없는 소리를 너무 당연하게 하는 거 아닌가?”

“밥맛을 논하다니, 아주 한국인 다 됐구만. 심지어 원래 컨셉은 외국인 아니었냐?”

findings.current: I sensed it before anyone else, and at the same time became aware of a tremendous presence that suddenly appeared high overhead.
findings.defect: “Sensed it” omits Jin’s feeling of déjà vu; the awareness of the presence is a separate, simultaneous realization.
findings.rationale: 기시감 is the feeling that something has happened before, while 깨달았다 separately describes his recognition of the presence.
findings.replacement: I felt a sense of déjà vu before anyone else, and at the same time became aware of a tremendous presence suddenly looming high overhead.
findings.source: 나는 그 누구보다 먼저 기시감을 느꼈고, 동시에 높은 허공 위에서 불현듯 드리워지는 거대한 기운의 존재를 깨달았다.

findings.current: Mr. Stone King, born in Atlanta, Georgia,
findings.defect: “Born in” asserts a birthplace where the source only says he is from Atlanta.
findings.rationale: 출신 establishes where he is from, not necessarily where he was born.
findings.replacement: Mr. Stone King, from Atlanta, Georgia,
findings.source: 미국 조지아주 애틀란타 출신의 스톤 킹 씨

summary: The draft loses a recognition cue and a food-based exchange, and changes a contrast in the Skeleton King’s dialogue.
